cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This page lists every cookie and browser-storage item the Miedăria Păunilor website uses, what each one is for, how long it is kept and whether it needs your consent.
cookiePolicy.whatTitle: What cookies and browser storage are
cookiePolicy.whatText: Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. Local storage and session storage work similarly but are never sent to our server automatically. We use them only to make the shop work and to remember the preferences you choose.
cookiePolicy.noTrackingText: We do not use analytics, advertising, social media or any other tracking cookies, and we do not share cookie data with third parties.
cookiePolicy.tableCaption: Cookies and browser storage used by this website

consent.preference: No, set only when you choose a theme

age_verified.purpose: Remembers that you confirmed you are of legal drinking age (18+), so the age check is not shown on every visit.

cookie_consent.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or declined optional cookies.

cart.purpose: Keeps the products and quantities you added to your cart.
cart.lifetime: 7 days after your last cart change

admin_session.purpose: Keeps shop administrators signed in. It is only sent to the administration area and never set for customers.

pending_checkout.purpose: Lets us release the bottles reserved for your order if you leave the payment page without paying.

easybox_locker.purpose: Remembers the easybox you chose on Sameday's map while you finish your order.

lang.purpose: Remembers your preferred language, so the home page opens in it.

i18nextLng.purpose: Remembers your preferred language for the site's text.

theme.purpose: Remembers the light or dark theme you picked. Nothing is stored while the site follows your device's theme.
theme.lifetime: Until you clear it or return to the device theme

newsletter_popup.purpose: Remembers that you closed the newsletter invitation (for 60 days) or subscribed, so it is not shown again. Without consent it is kept only until you close the tab (sessionStorage).
newsletter_popup.lifetime: 60 days after closing it; indefinitely after subscribing

__Host-customer_session.purpose: Keeps you logged in to your customer account. It only holds a random code; the server keeps just a fingerprint of it and forgets it when you log out.
__Host-customer_session.lifetime: Until you log out; ends after 7 days without use, and after 30 days at most

__Host-google_flow.purpose: Set only when you choose to continue with Google: holds one-time codes that tie Google's answer to this browser, so nobody else can complete the sign-in.
__Host-google_flow.lifetime: 10 minutes, deleted when you return from Google

cookiePolicy.thirdPartyText: Payments are processed on Stripe's own checkout page (checkout.stripe.com). Stripe sets its own cookies there, for example to prevent fraud, under its own policy.
cookiePolicy.samedayMapText: If you choose delivery to an easybox, Sameday's locker map opens from its own website (lockerplugin.sameday.ro) only when you click to choose a locker. It may ask for your location to show nearby lockers, and Sameday may set its own cookies there under its privacy policy. We receive only the locker you pick.
cookiePolicy.manageText: You can change your choice at any time. The button below shows the cookie banner again. If you decline, the optional preferences (language and newsletter invitation) are deleted straight away. You can also delete cookies and site data from your browser settings; the strictly necessary ones will be set again when you use the shop.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains what personal data Miedăria Păunilor collects when you use this website, why, on what legal basis, how long we keep it, who we share it with and what rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacyPolicy.controllerTitle: Who is responsible for your data
privacyPolicy.activitiesText: You can browse the shop and the blog without an account and without giving us any personal data. We process personal data only in the situations below.

orders.title: Orders and delivery
orders.data: Name, email address, phone number, the delivery address or the Sameday easybox you chose, the products ordered, the order and shipping amounts, your confirmation that you are 18 or older, and the language of the site you ordered from. You enter the address, phone number and name on the Stripe payment page, and we receive them once the payment is completed. If you are logged in, the order is also linked to your account and Stripe is given your account's email address. Once the parcel is handed to Sameday, we keep its waybill (AWB) number and delivery status.
orders.purpose: Delivering your order, contacting you about it, handling returns and complaints, and keeping the accounting records required by law.
orders.legalBasis: Performance of the sales contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)) and compliance with our legal obligations in accounting and taxation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
orders.retention: Paid orders are accounting records, kept for the period required by Romanian accounting law: 5 years from the end of the financial year they belong to (Legea contabilității nr. 82/1991). When that period ends, in the January after it, your name, email address, phone number, delivery address and the payment references are erased automatically; only an anonymous record of the amounts and products remains. The waybill number is erased with them. Unpaid orders are erased the same way 90 days after they end.

payments.title: Payments
payments.data: Card or other payment details. These are entered directly on Stripe's payment page and never reach our servers; we only receive the payment's status and a reference number.
payments.purpose: Taking payment for your order and preventing fraud.
payments.legalBasis: Performance of the sales contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). Stripe acts as an independent controller for the payment data it processes.
payments.retention: We keep the payment reference with the order and erase it together with the order's personal data (see Orders and delivery). Stripe keeps payment data under its own privacy policy.

accounts.title: Customer accounts
accounts.data: Email address, a password hash (we never store the password itself), the site language, the dates you registered and verified your address, your login sessions (stored only as fingerprints of random codes) and the link between your account and your orders. If you choose to continue with Google, we also receive from Google your email address and its account ID, and store the ID to recognise you; nothing else from your Google account. Orders placed with the account's verified address, including earlier guest orders, are linked to it.
accounts.purpose: Letting you log in and see your order history. Accounts are optional; every order can also be placed as a guest.
accounts.legalBasis: Performance of the contract you enter into by creating the account (Art. 6(1)(b)).
accounts.retention: Until you delete the account from its settings page, which erases it immediately; its orders are then kept only as described under Orders and delivery, detached from any account. Registrations whose password is never chosen are deleted after 24 hours; sessions end after 7 days without use and after 30 days at most. You can download all of your account data from its settings page.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.data: Email address, the site language you subscribed from, and the dates of your sign-up and confirmation.
newsletter.purpose: Sending you news about our meads and new blog posts, a few times a year.
newsletter.legalBasis: Your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), given through double opt-in: you are only subscribed after clicking the link in the confirmation email, and the confirmation date is our record of your consent.
newsletter.retention: Until you unsubscribe, using the link in any of our emails, which deletes your address immediately. Sign-ups that are not confirmed within 48 hours are deleted automatically.

contact.title: Messages you send us
contact.data: Your name, email address or phone number and the content of your message, when you write to us by email, phone or WhatsApp.
contact.legalBasis: Our legitimate interest in answering you (Art. 6(1)(f)), or steps you ask for before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).
contact.retention: As long as needed to deal with your request, and no longer than 2 years after our last exchange, unless the message is part of an order record.

statistics.title: Site statistics
statistics.data: The pages you open, how you arrived at the site (only its kind: direct, search engine, social network, email or another site), the products you view or add to the cart, the shop filters you pick and the site's language. To count each visitor once a day, your network address and browser type are combined into a code with a key that changes every day; neither they nor the code are stored. No cookie is used and nothing is saved on your device.
statistics.purpose: Understanding which pages and products interest visitors, so we can improve the shop and plan production. The figures are totals only, such as views of a product per day, and cannot be traced back to anyone.
statistics.legalBasis: Our legitimate interest in knowing how the shop is used (Art. 6(1)(f)). If your browser sends a Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control signal, nothing is counted for you.
statistics.retention: The daily codes are kept in memory only and deleted at midnight. The anonymous totals are kept for 2 years.

security.title: Security and technical logs
security.data: IP address, browser type (user agent), the page requested, the referring page and the time of the request. Query strings in addresses, where emailed links carry their codes, are not logged.
security.purpose: Keeping the website secure and available: rate limiting, detecting abuse and diagnosing errors. We do not use these logs to build profiles or for marketing.
security.legalBasis: Our legitimate interest in the security of the website (Art. 6(1)(f)).
security.retention: Logs are rotated automatically and overwritten once they reach a fixed size, usually within a few weeks. Rate-limiting counters, including those that slow down password guessing on an account, are kept in memory only, never contain your email address, and disappear within minutes. Login attempts are counted only as anonymous totals.

privacyPolicy.cookiesText: We also store a few cookies and browser-storage items, such as your cart and the confirmation that you are over 18. They are described in detail in our
privacyPolicy.recipientsText: We share personal data only with the service providers we need to run the shop, and only the data each one needs:

recipients.hosting: Our hosting provider, which runs the servers of this website in the European Union and processes the data above on our behalf.
recipients.stripe: Stripe Payments Europe Ltd. (Ireland), which processes payments.
recipients.brevo: Sendinblue SAS, operating as Brevo (France), which delivers our newsletter, confirmation and account emails on our behalf.
recipients.google: Google (Gmail), which hosts the mailbox we receive your emails in.
recipients.googleSignIn: Google Ireland Ltd., only if you choose to continue with Google: Google confirms your identity to us, and, as a separate controller, learns that you signed in to our website.
recipients.whatsapp: WhatsApp Ireland Ltd. (Meta), when you choose to message us on WhatsApp.
recipients.sameday: Sameday, the courier (Romania), which delivers your order: it receives your name, phone number and email address with the delivery address or the easybox you chose. If you choose an easybox, the locker map is Sameday's own and loads from its website.
recipients.authorities: Public authorities, such as the tax authority (ANAF), when the law requires us to.

privacyPolicy.noSaleText: We never sell your personal data or share it for advertising.
privacyPolicy.transfersText: We store your data in the European Union. Some of our providers (Stripe, Google and Meta) belong to groups based in the United States and may process data there. Such transfers are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacyPolicy.rightsText: Under the GDPR you have the right to:

rights.access: find out whether we process your data and receive a copy of it (access);
rights.erasure: have your data deleted, where we no longer need it or have no legal reason to keep it (erasure);
rights.restriction: ask us to restrict how we use your data (restriction);
rights.portability: receive the data you gave us in a common machine-readable format (portability);
rights.objection: object to processing based on our legitimate interest (objection);
rights.withdrawConsent: withdraw your consent at any time, for example by unsubscribing from the newsletter. This does not affect processing done before you withdrew it.

privacyPolicy.rightsHowTo: If you have an account, you can download all of its data or delete it yourself from the account settings. To exercise any of these rights in another way, write to us at
privacyPolicy.complaintText: We answer within one month. If you think we have not handled your data correctly, you can also file a complaint with the Romanian supervisory authority, Autoritatea Națională de Supraveghere a Prelucrării Datelor cu Caracter Personal (ANSPDCP),
privacyPolicy.securityText: The website is served only over encrypted connections (HTTPS), and payment details never reach our servers. Passwords are stored only as salted Argon2id hashes; login sessions and the codes in our emails are stored only as one-way hashes, so a copy of our database cannot be used to log in to anyone's account. Sensitive account changes require your password (or a fresh Google sign-in) again. Access to order data is limited to the shop's administrators, the database is not reachable from the internet, and the personal data in old orders is erased automatically once it no longer has to be kept.
privacyPolicy.automatedText: We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing, and we do not profile you.
privacyPolicy.minorsText: We sell alcoholic drinks, so this website is intended only for people aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect data from minors; if you believe a minor has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
privacyPolicy.changesText: We update this page when the way we process personal data changes. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to every order placed on this website. Please read them before ordering: by placing an order you accept them.

age.title: Age requirement
paragraphs: Our products are alcoholic drinks. Selling alcohol to people under 18 is forbidden (Law 61/1991), so only people aged 18 or over may order.

Before paying you confirm that you are 18 or older and that the parcel will be received by an adult. We may cancel an order, and the courier may refuse to hand over a parcel, if there is reason to believe the buyer or recipient is a minor.

orders.title: Orders and the contract
paragraphs: You add products to the cart, choose delivery, confirm your age and are taken to the payment page. Stock is reserved for 15 minutes while you pay.

The contract is concluded when the payment is confirmed, which the site shows you at the end of checkout. If an order cannot be fulfilled (for example a product turns out to be unavailable), we let you know and refund the amount paid in full.
An order may contain at most 100 bottles. We do not sell to resellers through this website.

prices.title: Prices
paragraphs: Prices are in Romanian lei (RON) and include all applicable taxes. The delivery charge is shown in the cart and on the payment page before you pay; delivery is free above the threshold shown in the cart.
On the English version of the site, prices in euro marked with * are indicative only, converted at the BNR exchange rate. You are always charged in lei; your bank may apply its own conversion.

payment.title: Payment
paragraphs: Payment is made online through Stripe, with the methods shown on the payment page (such as bank cards). We never see or store your card details.
Some payment methods confirm the payment later; the order is processed once the payment is confirmed. Cash on delivery is not available.

delivery.title: Delivery
paragraphs: We deliver within Romania through Sameday, either to the address you give on the payment page or to the easybox locker you choose in the cart. Parcels to a locker may weigh at most 18 kg.

We usually hand the parcel to Sameday within 2 business days of payment, and Sameday delivers within 1–3 business days. When the parcel leaves we email you the waybill (AWB) number and a tracking link. These times are estimates; if a delay is longer than 30 days you may cancel the order and get a full refund.

Please check the parcel on delivery and tell us within 2 business days, with photos, if it arrived damaged; we will replace the products or refund them. The risk passes to you when you, or the person you name, receive the parcel.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal (returns)
paragraphs: As a consumer you may withdraw from the contract within 14 days of receiving the products, without giving a reason (Government Emergency Ordinance 34/2014). To do so, send us a clear statement by email, for example using the standard form in annex 1 of the ordinance.
For health and hygiene reasons, the right of withdrawal does not apply to bottles that have been opened or whose seal has been broken after delivery (art. 16 e of the ordinance).

Send the products back within 14 days of telling us, unopened and well packed; the cost of returning them is yours. We refund the price and the standard delivery charge within 14 days of receiving your statement, with the same payment method, but we may wait until the products are back with us.

conformity.title: Legal guarantee of conformity
paragraphs: The products benefit from the legal guarantee of conformity (Government Emergency Ordinance 140/2021). If a product is not as described, is spoiled or past its best-before date when it reaches you, contact us and we will replace it or refund it.
Mead is a natural product: small variations in colour, clarity and sediment between lots are normal and are not defects. Store bottles away from light and heat.

accounts.title: Customer accounts
paragraphs: You can order without an account. If you create one, keep your password secret; you are responsible for what is done with your account. You can delete it at any time from its settings page.
We may suspend accounts used for fraud or abuse of the website.

liability.title: Liability
paragraphs: Drink responsibly. Do not drive after drinking alcohol, and do not drink alcohol while pregnant.

We take care that the information on the site is correct, but product photos are illustrative and errors can occur. If a price is obviously wrong, we will tell you before shipping and you may cancel the order with a full refund. Nothing in these terms limits your rights as a consumer under the law.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The texts, photos, logo and design of this website belong to the seller or are used with permission. They may not be copied or used commercially without our written consent.

law.title: Applicable law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Romanian law. Disputes that cannot be settled amicably are decided by the competent Romanian courts, without affecting the consumer protection rules of the country where you live.
